jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Abbott Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) is looking for a
Cloud Architect
for its global Pharma Division Headquarter based in Allschwil- Basel.

Primary Job Function:

The AA team is on a mission to reshape the entire EPD division around data-driven decision-making. The Cloud Architect collaborates closely with our Data Science team and our product delivery team to make sure that the applications we deploy are built on scalable and robust technology stack. These solutions directly transform the way we produce market and sell our products around the world.

This role focuses on designing and implementing cloud architectures that run AI/GenAI applications in a scalable way across multiple platforms (mobile, web etc..) used by our stakeholders around the world. You help our Engineering team to streamline or automate cloud infrastructure deployment, to enable other development teams to develop and deploy faster focusing on the application core.

Core Job Responsibilities:

Cloud Solution Architecture:

• Design and build, and maintain cloud architectures for scalable, robust AI/GenAI applications across platforms (web, mobile, desktop).

• Leverage cloud-native services to ensure optimal performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency.

• Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency, leveraging cloud-native monitoring and alerting tools.

• Design and implement load balancing, auto-scaling, and failover strategies to guarantee high availability across all deployed applications.

• Document reference architectures, technical roadmaps, and conduct design reviews with engineering and product teams.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation:

• Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) frameworks and automated workflows, making cloud deployment accessible to developers regardless of IaC expertise.

• Implement robust monitoring, security guardrails, and compliance checks to ensure infrastructure changes are safe, reliable, and aligned with production standards.

Security, Compliance, and Reliability:

• Champion secure cloud designs, ensuring compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements in coordination with our security team.

• Establish observability, monitoring and disaster recovery mechanisms for all AI/GenAI workloads.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering cloud-native applications, including at least 3 years specializing in AI/ML or GenAI workloads.

• Demonstrated experience with monitoring, optimizing, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency using modern observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).

• Expertise in AWS cloud services (e.g., ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, OPA, containerization with Docker/Kubernetes).

• AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer etc..) a plus.

• Full stack experience a plus.

• Experience supporting global deployments of multi-platform applications (web, mobile, desktop) across geographies (CDN).

• Proven communication skills. Fluency in English a must.

• Passion for transforming organizations through large scale data

Do you like the sound of this job and think you’ve got what it takes? Then send us your CV today. We look forward to receiving your application as pdf .

Il nostro portafoglio di tecnologie che cambiano la vita abbraccia lo spettro della salute, con aziende leader e prodotti nella diagnostica, dispositivi medici, nutrizioni e farmaci generici di marca. I nostri 114.000 colleghi servono persone in oltre 160 paesi. Abbott Stabilito Divisione Farmaceutica (EPD) sta cercando un Cloud Architect per il suo quartier generale della Divisione Farmacia globale con sede a Allschwil- Basel. Funzione di lavoro primario: Il team AA è in missione per rimodellare l'intera divisione EPD attorno al processo decisionale basato sui dati. Il Cloud Architect collabora a stretto contatto con il nostro team Data Science e con il nostro team di consegna prodotti per assicurarsi che le applicazioni che distribuiamo siano costruite su uno stack di tecnologia scalabile e robusto. Queste soluzioni trasformano direttamente il modo in cui produciamo mercato e vendiamo i nostri prodotti in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla progettazione e l'implementazione di architetture cloud che gestiscono applicazioni AI/GenAI in modo scalabile attraverso piattaforme multiple (mobile, web ecc.) utilizzate dai nostri stakeholder in tutto il mondo. Aiutate il nostro team Engineering a semplificare o automatizzare la distribuzione delle infrastrutture cloud, per consentire ad altri team di sviluppo di sviluppare e distribuire più velocemente concentrandosi sul core dell'applicazione. Responsabilità del lavoro: Cloud Solution Architecture:
• Progettare e costruire e mantenere architetture cloud per applicazioni AI/GenAI scalabili e robuste su piattaforme (web, mobile, desktop).
• Servizi cloud-native per garantire prestazioni ottimali, disponibilità, sicurezza e efficienza dei costi.
• Monitorare e ottimizzare l'infrastruttura cloud per la latenza, il throughput e l'efficienza dei costi, sfruttando strumenti di monitoraggio e allerta cloud-native.
• Progettare e implementare strategie di bilanciamento del carico, auto-scaling e failover per garantire elevata disponibilità in tutte le applicazioni impiegate.
• Architetture di riferimento del documento, roadmap tecniche e condurre recensioni di progettazione con team di ingegneria e prodotto. Infrastrutture come Code & Automation:
• Sviluppare e mantenere l'infrastruttura come framework code (IaC) e flussi di lavoro automatizzati, rendendo l'implementazione cloud accessibile agli sviluppatori indipendentemente dalla competenza IaC.
• Implementare controlli robusti, controlli di sicurezza e controlli di conformità per garantire che i cambiamenti delle infrastrutture siano sicuri, affidabili e allineati agli standard di produzione. Sicurezza, conformità e affidabilità:
• Campione design cloud sicuro, garantendo il rispetto della privacy dei dati, della sicurezza e dei requisiti normativi in coordinamento con il nostro team di sicurezza.
• Stabilire meccanismi di osservazione, monitoraggio e ripristino dei disastri per tutti i carichi di lavoro AI/GenAI. Preferiti:
• Laurea o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria, o una disciplina relativa.
• 8+ anni di esperienza di progettazione e fornitura di applicazioni cloud-native, tra cui almeno 3 anni specializzandosi nei carichi di lavoro AI/ML o GenAI.
• Esperienza dimostrata con monitoraggio, ottimizzazione e risoluzione dei problemi delle infrastrutture cloud per prestazioni, affidabilità e efficienza dei costi utilizzando strumenti di osservabilità moderni (ad esempio CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).
• Competenza nei servizi cloud AWS (ad esempio, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
• Proficienza in Infrastrutture come Codice (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) e moderne pratiche DevOps (CI/CD, OPA, containerizzazione con Docker/Kubernetes).
• Certificazione AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer ecc.) un plus.
• Piena esperienza stack un plus.
• Esperienza di supporto alle implementazioni globali di applicazioni multi-piattaforma (web, mobile, desktop) attraverso geografie (CDN).
• Prove capacità di comunicazione. Fluenza in inglese un must.

Notre portefeuille de technologies qui changent la vie couvre le spectre des soins de santé, avec des entreprises et des produits de premier plan dans le diagnostic, les dispositifs médicaux, la nutrition et les médicaments génériques de marque. Nos 114 000 collègues servent des gens dans plus de 160 pays. Abbott La Division pharmaceutique établie (DPE) cherche Architecte Cloud pour son siège mondial de la division Pharma basé à Allschwil-Bâle. Fonction principale : L'équipe AA est en mission de remodeler l'ensemble de la division EPD autour de la prise de décision axée sur les données. Le Cloud Architect collabore étroitement avec notre équipe Data Science et notre équipe de livraison de produits pour s'assurer que les applications que nous déployons sont construites sur une pile technologique évolutive et robuste. Ces solutions transforment directement la façon dont nous produisons le marché et vendons nos produits partout dans le monde. Ce rôle est axé sur la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures cloud qui gèrent les applications AI/GenAI de manière évolutive sur plusieurs plateformes (mobile, web, etc.) utilisées par nos parties prenantes à travers le monde. Vous aidez notre équipe d'ingénierie à rationaliser ou automatiser le déploiement de l'infrastructure cloud, afin de permettre à d'autres équipes de développement de se développer et de déployer plus rapidement en se concentrant sur le noyau d'application. Responsabilités essentielles au travail : Architecture des solutions en nuage :
• Concevoir et construire des architectures cloud pour des applications AI/GenAI évolutives et robustes sur toutes les plateformes (web, mobile, bureau).
• Tirer parti des services cloud-native pour assurer des performances optimales, disponibilité, sécurité et rentabilité.
• Surveiller et optimiser l'infrastructure cloud pour la latence, le débit et le rapport coût-efficacité, en tirant parti des outils de surveillance et d'alerte cloud-native.
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'équilibrage des charges, d'auto-échelle et de basculement pour garantir une grande disponibilité dans toutes les applications déployées.
• Documenter les architectures de référence, les feuilles de route techniques et effectuer des examens de conception avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de produits. Infrastructure comme code et automatisation :
• Développer et maintenir l'infrastructure en tant que cadres de code (IaC) et flux de travail automatisés, rendant le déploiement en nuage accessible aux développeurs, indépendamment de l'expertise IaC.
• Mettre en oeuvre une surveillance robuste, des garde-corps de sécurité et des contrôles de conformité pour s'assurer que les changements d'infrastructure sont sûrs, fiables et conformes aux normes de production. Sécurité, conformité et fiabilité :
• Des conceptions cloud sécurisées championnes, garantissant le respect de la confidentialité des données, de la sécurité et des exigences réglementaires en coordination avec notre équipe de sécurité.
• Mettre en place des mécanismes d'observation, de suivi et de reprise après sinistre pour toutes les charges de travail de l'IA/GenAI. Qualifications préférées :
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, ingénierie ou discipline connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'architecture et la fourniture d'applications cloud-native, y compris au moins 3 ans spécialisés dans les tâches AI/ML ou GenAI.
• Expérience démontrée en matière de surveillance, d'optimisation et de dépannage de l'infrastructure cloud pour la performance, la fiabilité et la rentabilité grâce à des outils modernes d'observation (par exemple CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).
• Expertise en services cloud AWS (par exemple, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
• Compétence en infrastructure comme code (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) et pratiques DevOps modernes (CI/CD, OPA, conteneurisation avec Docker/Kubernetes).
• AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, etc.) a plus.
• Pleine expérience de pile un plus.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Make a Meaningful Impact — Join Us as a Senior Manufacturing Engineer

About Us

Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott Laboratories, is a global leader in life-saving medical technologies. Our innovative systems, developed and manufactured in Zurich, support patients with advanced heart failure. With around 130 colleagues in development, quality, and production, we work together to make a real difference in people’s lives.

Why This Role Matters

As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer , you’ll play a vital role in ensuring the availability and compliance of our test equipment. You’ll collaborate with talented engineering teams and contribute to solutions that keep production running smoothly and patients safe.

What You’ll Do

• Build and qualify electrical and mechanical test equipment to ensure production continuity.

• Design and innovate new test equipment based on priorities, including validation of equipment, non-product software, and test methods.

• Take ownership of equipment availability and repairs, supporting the entire equipment lifecycle.

• Drive improvements through corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) related to equipment.

What We’re Looking For

• Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering .

• 3+ years of experience as an electrical or mechanical engineer.

• Strong understanding of electrical equipment and circuits .

• Proficiency in CAD design and troubleshooting electrical equipment.

• Familiarity with software (ideally C# ) and debugging.

• Experience with injection molding and validation processes (EIQ/EOQ & NPS) is a plus.

• Fluent in English ; German is an advantage.

• Knowledge of TestStand is an asset.

What Makes You Stand Out

• You enjoy problem-solving and finding creative solutions.

• You thrive in collaborative environments and value teamwork.

• You’re curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies.

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and fuller life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow

• A workplace in a fortune 500 company and the world’s leading manufacturer of medical devices

• A challenging position in a crisis independent industry

• To become part of a dynamic, highly educated, highly skilled, and motivated team

• Multi-national environment, where we foster the development of our talents within the enterprise

• Competitive compensations and benefits

• A workplace in the heart of Zurich

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Product Owner Advanced Analytics – Commercial

Abbott | Established Pharma Division (EPD), Basel HQ

About Abbott

At Abbott , we help people live fuller lives through better health. With more than 107,000 colleagues across 160+ countries , our work combines science, innovation, and care to improve health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business, we make trusted, high‑quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast‑growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our broad portfolio spans Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing meaningful and often unmet patient needs worldwide.

At Abbott, diverse perspectives strengthen our science, our decisions, and our impact . We are committed to creating an environment where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to contribute and grow.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Owner, Advanced Analytics – Commercial to join our central Advanced Analytics team at EPD Headquarters in Basel .
This role sits at the heart of Abbott EPD’s transformation into a data‑ and AI‑driven organization . As the Product Owner for Commercial Analytics, you will lead AI, Advanced Analytics, and GenAI initiatives that support Commercial Excellence, regional affiliates, and Finance , directly influencing business performance and decision‑making at a global scale.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Manufacturing Engineering – Maintenance & Facility Control

Zurich, Switzerland | Thoratec Switzerland GmbH (Abbott)

Build technology that saves lives — and grow while doing it.

At Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of the Abbott medical device division , we design and manufacture life‑saving blood pump systems that support patients with advanced heart failure around the world. Our technologies — including the CentriMag and HeartMate 3 — are developed and produced at our Zurich site and are used every day in critical care settings.

With around 140 colleagues in Development, Quality, and Production, our Zurich team combines deep technical expertise with a shared sense of purpose. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer – Maintenance and Facility Control who enjoys learning, collaborating, and contributing to something meaningful.

Your Role & Impact

In this role, you will help ensure that the production equipment and facility systems behind our life‑supporting medical devices operate safely, reliably, and compliantly. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Engineering, Quality, Production, and external partners in Switzerland and the US.
Your work directly contributes to our quality promise:
“Built as intended for your family.”

What You’ll Do

• Take ownership of maintenance and facility control processes , supporting high equipment availability and reliability

• Plan and implement improvement activities to strengthen compliant facility and utility operations

• Act as technical owner for assigned equipment, utilities, or facility systems throughout their lifecycle

• Manage change control activities in our PLM system (Windchill), including impact assessments and stakeholder training

• Ensure clear, accurate, and GMP‑compliant documentation in our asset management system (Infor)

• Plan and execute qualification and validation activities for equipment, facilities, and utilities

• Investigate deviations, non‑conformances, or incidents in close collaboration with Quality Engineering

• Lead improvement initiatives in area of responsibility or represent the department in large scale projects, e.g. in cooperation with Abbott sites in the US

• Support internal and external audits and inspections as a subject‑matter expert

• Ensure compliance with GMP, EHS, Abbott standards, and regulatory requirements

What We’re Looking For

Required

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (ETH/FH or equivalent)

• 1–4 years of relevant professional experience (early‑career profiles welcome)

• A structured, reliable, and independent working style

• Fluent English (C2) and communicative German

Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)

• Experience in medical devices or other regulated industries (ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820, GxP)

• Exposure to production support functions

• Experience or interest in qualification and validation activities

If you don’t meet all of these but feel excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Join Abbott / Thoratec?
At Abbott, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, valued, and able to grow. You can expect:

• Work that truly matters , improving and saving lives

• Career development opportunities in a global healthcare organization

• A stable role in a crisis‑resilient industry

• A collaborative, highly skilled, and international team

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• A modern workplace in the heart of Zurich

• An environment where we value diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration

Ready to Apply?
We are looking for a motivated and curious engineer who wants to grow, contribute, and be part of a mission‑driven team.
If this role resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you — even if you’re unsure you meet every requirement.

Abbott Jobs | Apply Now | Abbott Laboratories Careers

Global Medical Director – Cardiometabolic

Abbott | Established Pharmaceutical Division

About Abbott

At Abbott , we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially . As a global healthcare leader with more than 107,000 colleagues across 160+ countries , we develop life‑changing medicines and technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business, we make trusted, high‑quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast‑growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing real and often unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives, inclusive leadership, and collaboration are essential to building better outcomes for patients.
Your Impact

As Global Medical Director – Cardiometabolic , you will play a pivotal role in shaping Abbott’s global medical strategy for the Cardiometabolic therapeutic area. Working as a trusted partner across functions, you will help define both short‑ and long‑term direction , ensuring that medical decision‑making remains scientifically rigorous, patient‑focused, and globally aligned.

You will be a core member of the Medical Affairs Leadership Team within the Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), contributing your expertise and perspective to key strategic decisions across Medical Affairs, Innovation & Development.

What You Will Do

Medical Strategy & Scientific Leadership

• Lead the global medical strategy and activities for the Cardiometabolic therapeutic area and assigned products

• Collaborate closely with cross‑functional partners to translate scientific insight into meaningful medical and patient impact

• Identify unmet medical needs and mid‑ to long‑term opportunities for differentiation, innovation, and value creation

• Continuously evaluate products within scope, identifying portfolio gap‑filling opportunities , including in‑licensing considerations

• Develop therapeutic area medical plans , integrating research priorities, publication strategies, real‑world evidence, and study initiatives

• Prepare Target Product Profiles (TPPs) in partnership with cross‑functional teams

Evidence Generation & Governance

• Lead and govern Global Medical Affairs research projects , including IIS, post‑marketing studies, observational and epidemiologic research, Phase IV and RWE studies

• Serve as Chair of the Scientific Review Committee for GMA‑led clinical research activities

• Jointly review and approve clinical activities led by Clinical Development teams

• Drive high‑quality scientific content for digital initiatives aimed at both HCPs and patients

Collaboration, Safety & Compliance

• Build and sustain strong collaboration with regional and local Medical Directors , ensuring alignment between global strategy and local execution

• Establish and maintain trusted, ethical relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and scientific societies

• Act as a core member of the Product Safety Team , overseeing medical safety monitoring and contributing to PSURs, clinical overviews, and risk management plans

• As part of the Labeling Sub‑Team , provide medical input and scientific strategies for global and national label changes, including safety‑related updates

• Ensure that all medical and promotional activities comply with global guidelines and regulatory requirements

People Leadership

• Lead and develop one direct report , fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performing environment

• Attract, mentor, and retain talent through servant leadership , coaching, and empowerment

• Support a culture where diverse voices are encouraged and valued

Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology

Abbott | Established Pharmaceutical Division

About Abbott

At Abbott , we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially . As a global healthcare leader with more than 107,000 colleagues across 160+ countries , we develop life‑changing medicines and technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business, we make trusted, high‑quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast‑growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing real and often unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives and inclusive leadership are essential to delivering better outcomes for patients globally.
Your Impact

As Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology , you will play a central role in shaping Abbott’s global medical strategy for the GI therapeutic area. Working closely with cross‑functional partners, you will help define short‑ and long‑term direction , ensuring medical decision‑making is scientifically robust, patient‑centered, and aligned with global and local needs.

You will be a core member of the Medical Affairs Leadership Team within the Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), contributing your expertise and perspective to strategic decisions across Medical Affairs and Innovation & Development.

Medical Strategy & Scientific Leadership

• Lead the global medical strategy and activities for the Gastroenterology therapeutic area and assigned products

• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to translate scientific insight into meaningful medical and patient impact

• Identify unmet medical needs and mid‑ to long‑term opportunities for differentiation, innovation, and value creation

• Continuously evaluate products within scope, identifying portfolio gap‑filling opportunities , including in‑licensing considerations

• Develop therapeutic area medical plans , integrating research priorities, publication strategies, real‑world evidence, and study initiatives

• Prepare Target Product Profiles (TPPs) in partnership with cross‑functional teams

• Drive scientific excellence by reviewing medical literature and generating differentiated ideas (including digital) to strengthen disease management and patient care

Evidence Generation & Governance

• Serve as a member of the Scientific Review Committee , jointly reviewing and approving clinical activities led by Clinical Development

• Ensure high‑quality medical content for digital initiatives aimed at both HCPs and patients

Collaboration, Safety & Compliance

• Build and maintain strong collaboration with regional and local Medical Directors , ensuring alignment between global strategy and local execution

• Establish and sustain trusted, ethical relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and scientific societies

• Act as a core member of the Product Safety Team , overseeing medical safety monitoring and contributing to PSURs, clinical overviews, and risk‑management plans

• As part of the Labeling Sub‑Team , provide medical input and scientific strategies for global and national label changes, including safety‑related updates

• Ensure that all medical and promotional activities comply with global guidelines and regulatory requirements

People Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two direct reports , fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performing environment

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH is part of the medical device division of Abbott Laboratories , a fortune 500 company with over 115’000 employees worldwide. We are the global market leader for implantable and extracorporeal blood pumps based on magnetic levitation technology. Our life-saving systems, which we develop and manufacture in Zurich, are used for advanced heart failure patients needing short- or long-term circulatory support.

Our location in the heart of the city of Zurich has around 130 employees in the areas of development, quality and production of the CentriMag System and the HeartMate 3. We are looking for a motivated and talented

Senior Mechatronics Engineer

to join our R&D team in Zurich. Become a part of an aspiring team responsible for developing next generation centrifugal blood pumps and circulatory support systems , as well as supporting manufacturing engineering and quality teams to sustain production of on-market products.

This role is ideal for an engineer with expertise in electromagnetic motor design, control systems, and electrical engineering , who enjoys working on complex, regulated medical devices that directly impact patient outcomes. You will play a key technical role in the design, modeling, and control of electromagnetically driven motors used in blood pumps, working closely with systems, firmware, and verification teams to bring innovative products from concept through commercialization.

With your work, you’ll ensure these life-saving products stay at the forefront of innovation and meet the highest standards of our industry. In your role you will be interfacing and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Switzerland and the United States.

Main Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and optimize electromagnetic motors for implantable and extracorporeal blood pump medical devices; experience with magnetically levitated systems is a strong plus.

• Develop and evaluate motor concepts and topologies, balancing performance, controllability, size constraints, manufacturability, and long-term reliability.

• Perform electromagnetic and thermo-magnetic analyses, including FEM-based simulations, to optimize torque, efficiency, losses, thermal performance, and stray magnetic fields.

• Model and optimize key loss mechanisms (copper, iron, eddy current, and control-related losses), and conduct system-level efficiency and thermal trade-off studies.

• Translate analytical and simulation results into concrete design improvements and correlate predictions with experimental and prototype test data.

• Develop and analyze motor control strategies (current, speed, torque, and position control) to ensure stable and precise pump operation.

• Collaborate closely with power electronics and firmware teams to integrate motor drives, sensing, and feedback systems.

• Support system integration, test definition, characterization testing, and root-cause analysis across motor, electronics, and control domains.

• Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on motor components and build processes.

• Support sustaining projects for on-market products, e.g. obsolescence projects, complaint investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs)

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or closely-related field (ETH/FH or comparable education)

• 5+ years of experience in new product development for medical devices, ideally active implantable or life-sustaining Class 2 or Class 3 devices

• Strong background in electromagnetics, motor design, and motor control, including hands-on experience with motor drives, power electronics, and embedded control systems.

• Demonstrate solid understanding of control systems theory, including linear control, stability analysis, feedback systems, PID control, and state space concepts.

• Proficiency with modeling and analysis tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, electromagnetic simulation software).

• Experien

DESCRIZIONE: Thoratec Svizzera GmbH fa parte della divisione dispositivi medici di Abbott Laboratories , una società di fortuna 500 con oltre 115’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo. Siamo il leader del mercato globale per le pompe di sangue impiantabili e extracorporee basate sulla tecnologia di levitazione magnetica. I nostri sistemi salvavita, che sviluppiamo e produciamo a Zurigo, sono utilizzati per i pazienti con insufficienza cardiaca avanzata che necessitano di supporto circolatorio a breve o lungo termine. La nostra posizione nel cuore della città di Zurigo ha circa 130 dipendenti nei settori dello sviluppo, della qualità e della produzione del sistema CentriMag e del HeartMate 3. Siamo alla ricerca di un motivato e di talento Ingegnere Mechatronics senior per unirsi alla nostra squadra R&D a Zurigo. Diventa parte di un team di aspiranti responsabili dello sviluppo di pompe di sangue centrifughe di nuova generazione e sistemi di supporto circolatorio, oltre a sostenere team di ingegneria manifatturiera e di qualità per sostenere la produzione di prodotti on-market. Questo ruolo è ideale per un ingegnere con esperienza nella progettazione di motori elettromagnetici, sistemi di controllo e ingegneria elettrica , che gode di lavorare su dispositivi medici complessi e regolamentati che colpiscono direttamente i risultati del paziente. Si svolgerà un ruolo tecnico fondamentale nella progettazione, modellazione e controllo dei motori azionati elettromagneticamente utilizzati nelle pompe del sangue, lavorando a stretto contatto con sistemi, firmware e team di verifica per portare prodotti innovativi dal concetto attraverso la commercializzazione. Con il tuo lavoro, ti assicurerai che questi prodotti salvavita restino all'avanguardia nell'innovazione e soddisfino i più elevati standard del nostro settore. Nel vostro ruolo vi sarete confrontati e collaborando con squadre interfunzionali in Svizzera e negli Stati Uniti. Principali responsabilità
• Progettare, sviluppare e ottimizzare i motori elettromagnetici per dispositivi medici impiantabili e extracorporei; l'esperienza con sistemi magneticamente levitati è un vantaggio forte.
• Sviluppare e valutare concetti e topologie motorie, bilanciare le prestazioni, controllabilità, vincoli di dimensione, manufacturability e affidabilità a lungo termine.
• Eseguire analisi elettromagnetiche e termomagnetiche, comprese le simulazioni basate su FEM, per ottimizzare la coppia, l'efficienza, le perdite, le prestazioni termiche e i campi magnetici randagi.
• Modellare e ottimizzare i meccanismi di perdita chiave (copper, ferro, corrente eddy e perdite correlate al controllo), e condurre gli studi di efficienza e di scambio termico a livello di sistema.
• Tradurre risultati analitici e di simulazione in miglioramenti concreti di progettazione e correlati previsioni con dati di prova sperimentali e prototipi.
• Sviluppare e analizzare le strategie di controllo del motore (corrente, velocità, coppia e controllo della posizione) per garantire un funzionamento stabile e preciso della pompa.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con l'elettronica di potenza e i team del firmware per integrare motori, sensori e sistemi di feedback.
• Integrazione del sistema di supporto, definizione di test, test di caratterizzazione e analisi root-cause attraverso i domini motore, elettronica e controllo.
• Collaborare con fornitori e partner di produzione sui componenti motore e sui processi di costruzione.
• Sostegno a progetti di sostegno per i prodotti sul mercato, ad esempio progetti di obsolescenza, indagini sui reclami, azioni correttive e preventive (CAPA) Qualificazioni richieste
• Corso di laurea in Meccatronica, Ingegneria Elettrica, o campo strettamente correlato (ETH/FH o formazione comparabile)
• 5+ anni di esperienza nel nuovo sviluppo di prodotti per dispositivi medici, impiantibili idealmente attivi o dispositivi di Classe 2 o Classe 3
• Forte background in elettromagnetici, progettazione del motore e controllo del motore, tra cui esperienza pratica con motoriduttori, elettronica di potenza e sistemi di controllo incorporati.
• Dimostrare una solida comprensione della teoria dei sistemi di controllo, tra cui controllo lineare, analisi della stabilità, sistemi di feedback, controllo PID e concetti di spazio di stato.
• Proficienza con strumenti di modellazione e analisi (ad esempio, MATLAB/Simulink, software di simulazione elettromagnetica).

Wir sind Weltmarktführer für implantierbare und extrakorporale Blutpumpen auf Basis der Magnetschwebetechnologie. Unsere lebensrettenden Systeme, die wir in Zürich entwickeln und herstellen, werden für Patienten mit fortgeschrittener Herzinsuffizienz eingesetzt, die kurz- oder langfristige Kreislaufunterstützung benötigen. Unser Standort im Herzen der Stadt Zürich beschäftigt rund 130 Mitarbeiter in den Bereichen Entwicklung, Qualität und Produktion des CentriMag Systems und des HeartMate 3. Wir suchen einen motivierten und talentierten Senior Mechatronik-Ingenieur, der sich unserem R&D-Team in Zürich anschließt. Werden Sie Teil eines aufstrebenden Teams, das für die Entwicklung von Zentrifugalblutpumpen und Kreislaufunterstützungssystemen der nächsten Generation verantwortlich ist, sowie für die Unterstützung von Fertigungstechnik und Qualitätsteams, um die Produktion von On-Market-Produkten aufrechtzuerhalten. Diese Rolle ist ideal für einen Ingenieur mit Know-how in elektromagnetischen Motor-Design, Steuerungssysteme und Elektrotechnik, der gerne an komplexen, regulierten medizinischen Geräten arbeitet, die direkt Auswirkungen auf die Patientenergebnisse haben. Sie spielen eine wichtige technische Rolle bei der Konstruktion, Modellierung und Steuerung von elektromagnetisch angetriebenen Motoren, die in Blutpumpen verwendet werden, und arbeiten eng mit Systemen, Firmware und Verifizierungsteams zusammen, um innovative Produkte vom Konzept bis zur Kommerzialisierung zu bringen. Mit Ihrer Arbeit stellen Sie sicher, dass diese lebensrettenden Produkte an der Spitze der Innovation bleiben und die höchsten Standards unserer Branche erfüllen. In Ihrer Funktion arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams in der Schweiz und den USA zusammen. Hauptverantwortung
• Design, Entwicklung und Optimierung elektromagnetischer Motoren für implantierbare und extrakorporale medizinische Blutpumpengeräte; Erfahrung mit magnetisch schwebenden Systemen ist ein starkes Plus.
• Entwicklung und Bewertung von Motorkonzepten und -topologien, Bilanzierleistung, Steuerbarkeit, Größenbeschränkungen, Herstellbarkeit und langfristige Zuverlässigkeit.
• Führen Sie elektromagnetische und thermomagnetische Analysen durch, einschließlich FEM-basierter Simulationen, um Drehmoment, Effizienz, Verluste, thermische Leistung und Streumagnetfelder zu optimieren.
• Modellierung und Optimierung von Schlüsselverlustmechanismen (Kupfer-, Eisen-, Wirbelstrom- und steuerungsbedingte Verluste) und Durchführung von Effizienz- und Thermokompromissstudien auf Systemebene.
• Übersetzen von Analyse- und Simulationsergebnissen in konkrete Designverbesserungen und korrelieren Vorhersagen mit experimentellen und Prototyp-Testdaten.
• Entwicklung und Analyse von Motorsteuerungsstrategien (Strom-, Drehzahl-, Drehmoment- und Positionssteuerung), um einen stabilen und präzisen Pumpenbetrieb zu gewährleisten.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Teams für Leistungselektronik und Firmware zur Integration von Motorantrieben, Sensorik und Feedback-Systemen.
• Unterstützung von Systemintegration, Testdefinition, Charakterisierungstests und Wurzelursachenanalyse in Motor-, Elektronik- und Steuerungsdomänen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten und Fertigungspartnern an Motorkomponenten und Bauprozessen.
• Unterstützung von Projekten für On-Market-Produkte, z. B. Obsoleszenzprojekte, Reklamationsuntersuchungen, Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen (CAPAs) Erforderliche Qualifikationen
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder eng verwandten Bereich (ETH / FH oder vergleichbare Ausbildung)
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung neuer Produkte für medizinische Geräte, idealerweise aktive implantierbare oder lebenserhaltende Klasse 2 oder Klasse 3 Geräte
• Starker Hintergrund in Elektromagnetik, Motordesign und Motorsteuerung, einschließlich praktischer Erfahrung mit Motorantrieben, Leistungselektronik und eingebetteten Steuerungssystemen. Demonstrieren Sie ein solides Verständnis der Theorie der Kontrollsysteme, einschließlich linearer Steuerung, Stabilitätsanalyse, Feedback-Systeme, PID-Steuerung und Zustandsraumkonzepte.
• Kenntnisse mit Modellierungs- und Analysewerkzeugen (z. B. MATLAB/Simulink, elektromagnetische Simulationssoftware).

Nous sommes le leader mondial des pompes sanguines implantables et extracorporelles basées sur la technologie de lévitation magnétique. Nos systèmes de sauvetage, que nous développons et fabriquons à Zurich, sont utilisés pour les patients ayant une insuffisance cardiaque avancée nécessitant un soutien circulatoire à court ou à long terme. Notre emplacement au cœur de la ville de Zurich compte environ 130 collaborateurs dans les domaines du développement, de la qualité et de la production du CentriMag System et du HeartMate 3. Nous cherchons une motivation et un talent Ingénieur Mécatronic senior pour rejoindre notre équipe de R-D à Zurich. Devenez membre d'une équipe aspirante responsable du développement de pompes à sang centrifuges de prochaine génération et de systèmes de soutien circulatoire, ainsi que de soutenir les équipes d'ingénierie et de qualité de fabrication pour soutenir la production de produits sur le marché. Ce rôle est idéal pour un ingénieur spécialisé dans la conception de moteurs électromagnétiques, les systèmes de commande et le génie électrique, qui aime travailler sur des dispositifs médicaux complexes et réglementés qui ont une incidence directe sur les résultats des patients. Vous jouerez un rôle technique clé dans la conception, la modélisation et le contrôle des moteurs électromagnétiques utilisés dans les pompes sanguines, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les systèmes, les firmwares et les équipes de vérification pour apporter des produits innovants du concept à la commercialisation. Grâce à votre travail, vous veillerez à ce que ces produits vitaux restent à l'avant-garde de l'innovation et répondent aux normes les plus élevées de notre industrie. Dans votre rôle, vous interagirez et collaborerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles en Suisse et aux États-Unis. Principales responsabilités
• Concevoir, développer et optimiser les moteurs électromagnétiques pour les dispositifs médicaux de pompes sanguines implantables et extracorporelles; l'expérience avec les systèmes lévités magnétiquement est un plus fort.
• Développer et évaluer les concepts et les topologies moteurs, équilibrer les performances, contrôler les contraintes de taille, de fabrication et de fiabilité à long terme.
• Effectuer des analyses électromagnétiques et thermomagnétiques, y compris des simulations basées sur la FEM, pour optimiser le couple, l'efficacité, les pertes, les performances thermiques et les champs magnétiques errants.
• Modéliser et optimiser les principaux mécanismes de perte (cuivre, fer, courant de Foucault et pertes liées au contrôle), et effectuer des études d'efficacité et de compensation thermique au niveau du système.
• Traduire les résultats d'analyse et de simulation en améliorations concrètes de la conception et en corrélation avec des données expérimentales et des essais prototypes.
• Élaborer et analyser des stratégies de commande du moteur (courant, régime, couple et contrôle de position) pour assurer un fonctionnement stable et précis de la pompe.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'électronique de puissance et de firmware pour intégrer les moteurs, la détection et les systèmes de rétroaction.
• Prise en charge de l'intégration du système, de la définition des tests, des tests de caractérisation et de l'analyse des causes profondes dans les domaines moteurs, électroniques et de contrôle.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Shape the Future of Healthcare with Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader dedicated to helping people live their best lives at every stage. Our portfolio spans life-changing technologies in diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines. With 114,000 colleagues serving patients in 160+ countries, we are committed to advancing health worldwide.
At Abbott, we believe diverse perspectives make better decisions—and ultimately lead to better healthcare outcomes.

About the Role

Are you passionate about improving patient access and making data-driven decisions that create real-world impact?

We are looking for a Tender Specialist to join Abbott’s Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD). In this role, you will work closely with the Global Tender Management Head and cross-functional teams to strengthen our tender capabilities, enhance processes, and support markets in delivering winning strategies.
This position offers strong exposure to global markets, senior stakeholders, and strategic initiatives—while giving you the opportunity to grow your expertise and shape how Abbott brings medicines to patients.

What You’ll Do

Market & Customer Insights

• Support analysis of customer and market data to inform tender strategies

• Track market trends and pricing dynamics to identify opportunities and risks

Tender Strategy & Performance

• Partner with the Global Tender Management Head to support strategy execution

• Monitor KPIs and prepare insights for stakeholders

• Collaborate with markets on high-priority tenders to maximize success

Processes & Tools

• Help ensure consistent application of Abbott’s global tender process

• Support adoption and effective use of tender management systems

• Contribute to continuous improvements that enhance efficiency and outcomes

Planning & Coordination

• Help maintain visibility of upcoming tender opportunities (9–12 months ahead)

• Support preparation of cross-functional plans for key tenders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with teams across finance, supply chain, pricing, marketing, and local markets

• Facilitate communication across regions and functions

• Support and coordinate Tender Review Panels when needed

Capability Building

• Support development of tools, training materials, and best practices

• Help strengthen capabilities across local teams

Customer Value

• Contribute to the development of compelling value propositions tailored to customer needs

Ethics & Compliance

• Ensure adherence to Abbott policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards

What You Bring

We recognize that great candidates don’t always check every box. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn’t perfectly match every requirement.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree or MBA is a plus, not a requirement)

Experience

• Experience in project management, commercial roles, or healthcare/pharma environments

• Exposure to tender processes or pricing strategies is an advantage

• Experience working across teams or regions is beneficial

Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to turn data into insights and actionable recommendations

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence across teams

• Clear communication and stakeholder management skills

• Interest in learning and developing in a global environment

Why Join Abbott?

• Meaningful impact : Contribute to improving access to treatments worldwide

• Growth & development : Mentoring, training, and career progression opportunities

• Inclusive culture : We value different perspectives and promote an environment where everyone can thrive

• Global exposure : Work with teams across regions and functions

Interested?

If this role sounds like a fit for you—or even if you’re not sure but are curious—we’d love to hear from you.

(Senior) Financial Analyst – Drive Impact in Life-Saving Innovation

Location: Zurich, Switzerland

At Abbott’s Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , we develop technology that saves lives. As part of Abbott’s global medical device division (115,000+ employees worldwide), we are leaders in implantable and extracorporeal blood pump systems using advanced magnetic levitation technology.

From our Zurich site, a diverse team of ~130 colleagues collaborates across development, quality, and production to deliver the CentriMag System and HeartMate 3—supporting patients with advanced heart failure around the world.

Why this role matters

As a (Senior) Financial Analyst , you will play a key role in shaping financial insights that directly support innovation and patient impact. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams and leadership to help drive operational excellence, transparency, and smart decision-making.
This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise with meaningful purpose , while growing into a strategic finance partner within a collaborative and supportive environment.

• Act as a trusted finance partner for cost centers, capital investments, projects, inventory and windchill change orders

• A modern workplace in the heart of Zurich

JOB DESCRIPTION: (Senior) Financial Analyst – Drive Impact in Life-Saving Innovation Location: Zurich, Switzerland At Abbott’s Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , we develop technology that saves lives. As part of Abbott’s global medical device division (115,000+ employees worldwide), we are leaders in implantable and extracorporeal blood pump systems using advanced magnetic levitation technology. From our Zurich site, a diverse team of ~130 colleagues collaborates across development, quality, and production to deliver the CentriMag System and HeartMate 3—supporting patients with advanced heart failure around the world. Why this role matters As a (Senior) Financial Analyst , you will play a key role in shaping financial insights that directly support innovation and patient impact. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams and leadership to help drive operational excellence, transparency, and smart decision-making. This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise with meaningful purpose , while growing into a strategic finance partner within a collaborative and supportive environment. What you’ll do
• Act as a trusted finance partner for cost centers, capital investments, projects, inventory and windchill change orders
• Lead and support annual budgeting process and periodic forecasting process across assigned areas
• Partner with the business to monitor performance, identify opportunities, and support improvement initiatives
• Support full cycle of capital (planning, tracking, and post-investment)
• Monitor inventory and communicate financial implications and opportunities by partnering with local supply chain
• Contribute to continuous improvement in financial processes, tools, reporting and data accuracy
• Ensure compliance with financial controls, policies, and reporting requirements
• Execute deliverables in a consistent, timely, and accurate manner
• Play a key role in month-end activities by executing journal entries, performing variance analysis, and preparing reports What you bring We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.
• Degree in Finance (or similar), with approximately 5+ years of experience, with at least 3 years in FP&A
• Experience in manufacturing or operations finance is a plus, but not essential
• Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
• Ability to translate financial data into clear insights for different audiences
• Confidence working with systems and data (e.g., SAP, Dodeca/ Essbase, Excel and Power BI)
• Strong collaboration and communication skills
• Ability to manage priorities and navigate a dynamic environment and high-pressure situations
• Fluent English What we offer
• A purpose-driven role contributing to life-saving technologies
• A collaborative and inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued
• Opportunities for growth and specialization (including becoming a costing SME)
• Flexibility and autonomy in how you manage your work
• A modern workplace in the heart of Zurich Join us We are looking for curious, motivated individuals who enjoy solving problems, working together, and making an impact. If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. Apply via our career site: Abbott Laboratories Careers The base pay for this position is N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted. JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott Laboratories, is a global leader in life-saving medical technologies. Our innovative systems, developed and manufactured in Zurich, support patients with advanced heart failure. With around 130 colleagues in development, quality, and production, we work together to make a real difference in people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Process Validations and Equipment Qualification:

• Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to validate processes and qualify equipment.

• Evaluate, review, and approve validation and qualification plans, reports, and risk files.

Non-Conforming Material (NCMR) Handling:

• Manage the complete handling of non-conforming materials (NCMR).

• Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) based on NCMR findings.

• Document, track, and trend NCMRs, ensuring timely and effective corrections.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve non-conformance issues and prevent recurrence.

Root Cause Analysis:

• Lead root cause analysis and problem-solving activities for quality issues.

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances.

• Drive the CAPA process to identify root causes of quality issues, implement corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness.

• Develop preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze and report trends and statistical data from investigations in collaboration with Manufacturing Engineering and company management.

Audit Participation:

• Participate in internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and support.

• Act as an NCMR Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, procurement, and manufacturing, to address quality-related issues.

Continuous Improvement:

• Champion continuous improvement initiatives within the quality department.

• Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance product quality and process efficiency.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field.

• Experience in medical devices or a similar industry.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality engineering, with a focus on NCMR, validations, and CAPA.

• Strong knowledge of quality management systems and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis methodologies.

• Proficient in using quality tools and software.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

• In-depth experience in process and test method validation (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) and the application of statistical methods.

• Experience with CAPA processes.

• Proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.

Reporting/Supervisory Structure:

• Reporting line according to the Organizational Chart.

• Demonstrates ability as an individual contributor.

• Works under management direction.

• Fulfills tasks based on delegated competencies given from management.

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and fuller life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow

• A workplace in a fortune 500 company and the world’s leading manufacturer of medical devices

• A challenging position in a crisis independent industry

• To become part of a dynamic, highly educated, highly skilled, and motivated team

• Multi-national environment, where we foster the development of our talents within the enterprise

• Competitive compensations and benefits

• A workplace in the heart of Zurich

• Investigare e risolvere le non conformità.

• Sviluppare misure preventive per evitare il ripetersi. Analisi e reporting dei dati:

• Implementare le migliori pratiche e soluzioni innovative per migliorare la qualità dei prodotti e l'efficienza dei processi. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in ingegneria, gestione della qualità o in un campo correlato.
• Esperienza in dispositivi medici o in un settore simile.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria della qualità, con particolare attenzione a NCMR, convalide e CAPA.
• Conoscenza approfondita dei sistemi di gestione della qualità e dei requisiti normativi.
• Eccellenti capacità di problem solving ed esperienza con le metodologie di analisi delle cause profonde.
• Competente nell'uso di strumenti e software di qualità.
• Forti capacità comunicative e interpersonali, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente di squadra.
• Esperienza approfondita nella validazione di processi e metodi di prova (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) e nell'applicazione di metodi statistici.
• Esperienza con i processi CAPA.
• Conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese sia scritta che parlata. Struttura di reporting/vigilanza:
• Linea di riporto secondo l'Organigramma.
• Dimostra abilità come collaboratore individuale.
• Lavora sotto la direzione della direzione.
• Svolge compiti basati sulle competenze delegate fornite dalla direzione. Lavorare in Abbott In Abbott puoi svolgere il lavoro che conta e aiutare le persone a vivere una vita più sana e piena, far crescere la tua carriera e imparare, essere te stesso. Avrai accesso a:

• Un posto di lavoro in un'azienda Fortune 500 e il principale produttore mondiale di dispositivi medici
• Una posizione stimolante in un settore indipendente dalla crisi
• Entrare a far parte di un team dinamico, altamente istruito, altamente qualificato e motivato

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott Laboratories, is a global leader in life-saving medical technologies. Our innovative systems, developed and manufactured in Zurich, support patients with advanced heart failure. With around 130 colleagues in development, quality, and production, we work together to make a real difference in people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Process Validations and Equipment Qualification:

• Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to validate processes and qualify equipment.

• Evaluate, review, and approve validation and qualification plans, reports, and risk files.

Non-Conforming Material (NCMR) Handling:

• Manage the complete handling of non-conforming materials (NCMR).

• Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) based on NCMR findings.

• Document, track, and trend NCMRs, ensuring timely and effective corrections.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve non-conformance issues and prevent recurrence.

Root Cause Analysis:

• Lead root cause analysis and problem-solving activities for quality issues.

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances.

• Drive the CAPA process to identify root causes of quality issues, implement corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness.

• Develop preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze and report trends and statistical data from investigations in collaboration with Manufacturing Engineering and company management.

Audit Participation:

• Participate in internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and support.

• Act as an NCMR Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, procurement, and manufacturing, to address quality-related issues.

Continuous Improvement:

• Champion continuous improvement initiatives within the quality department.

• Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance product quality and process efficiency.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field.

• Experience in medical devices or a similar industry.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality engineering, with a focus on NCMR, validations, and CAPA.

• Strong knowledge of quality management systems and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis methodologies.

• Proficient in using quality tools and software.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

• In-depth experience in process and test method validation (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) and the application of statistical methods.

• Experience with CAPA processes.

• Proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.

Reporting/Supervisory Structure:

• Reporting line according to the Organizational Chart.

• Demonstrates ability as an individual contributor.

• Works under management direction.

• Fulfills tasks based on delegated competencies given from management.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and fuller life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow

• A workplace in a fortune 500 company and the world’s leading manufacturer of medical devices

• A challenging position in a crisis independent industry

• To become part of a dynamic, highly educated, highly skilled, and motivated team

• Multi-national environment, where we foster the development of our talents within the enterprise

• Competitive compensations and benefits

• A workplace in the heart of Zurich

The Director, Commercial Excellence for Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA) Structural Heart serves as a member of the EMEA Divisional Vice President’s senior staff. The Director collaborates across functions and with the respective country General Managers to deliver on commercial execution tactics that drive business growth and market expansion. This role reports into Structural Heart’s Divisional VP for Global Commercial Excellence and will be based within an EMEA major market (preferably Abbott offices in Belgium, Germany or UK). Requires up to 25% travel.

Strategy, Commercial Planning

• Support DVP in strategic decision-making by transforming market intelligence, field team experiences, and sales metrics into data-driven insights. Bring expertise for creating strategic frameworks and scenario analyses.

• Identify growth opportunities across product franchises and countries based on local dynamics.

• Work collaboratively with Marketing and Country General Managers to deliver EMEA’s growth agenda and to ensure respective Country alignment and progress with strategic priorities.

• In conjunction with DVP, coordinate periodic business reviews with Countries to identify and address business issues, opportunities, win/loss customer analysis to ensure progress toward business objectives.

• Provide frameworks to track sales activity and overall execution toward EMEA achieving commercial goals . Example activities: drive alignment of EMEA-consistent dashboards/KPIs, recommend product mix optimizations, analyze sales force alignments/expansion options, track competitive share shifting.

• Identify specific drivers of execution gaps. Craft structure to share best practices. Support development of commercial playbooks.

• Collaborate with Marketing to organize field communication cadence and to analyze market data for account segmentation/targeting insights that feed EMEA commercial strategy.

• Partner with Director, Structural Heart Commercial Data to optimize meaningful performance metrics and dashboards. Articulate business needs to commercial data team for building field inputs into SFDC and for producing monthly KPI dashboards.
